articles.title: Radiation-induced contrast enhancement in patients with IDH-mutated gliomas: incidence, risk factors, and impact of radiotherapy modality - a systematic review
articles.summary: This systematic review investigates the incidence and risk factors associated with radiation-induced contrast enhancement (RICE) in patients with IDH-mutated gliomas treated with proton therapy. The study addresses the clinical challenge of distinguishing RICE from tumor progression to improve patient management and outcomes.

articles.title: Paediatric radiotherapy in Denmark from 2008 to 2024: implementation of improved radiotherapeutic technologies
articles.summary: This nationwide study documents 16 years of technological advancements in pediatric radiotherapy implementation. The findings emphasize the role of clinical trials in driving the adoption of state-of-the-art conformal techniques for pediatric oncology.

articles.title: Advances in Radiotherapy for Glioblastoma and IDH-Mutant High-Grade Astrocytoma: A Biological and Mechanistic Perspective
articles.summary: This narrative review evaluates the current state of radiotherapy for high-grade gliomas, synthesizing biological and mechanistic data. It examines the reference standard of 60 Gy partial-brain regimens in the context of emerging molecular and clinical evidence.

articles.title: From Imaging Guidance to Dosimetric and Staging Superiority: Impact of 68Ga-PSMA PET/CT and mpMRI on Target Delineation
articles.summary: This single-center retrospective study analyzes how the integration of 68Ga-PSMA PET/CT and mpMRI influences target volume personalization and organs-at-risk sparing in prostate cancer radiotherapy. The results highlight the potential for improved staging and dosimetric precision with advanced imaging.

articles.title: Long-Term Outcomes After Pencil Beam Scanning Carbon Ion Radiotherapy for Unresectable Retroperitoneal Sarcomas
articles.summary: This study demonstrates the safety and clinical efficacy of pencil beam scanning carbon ion radiotherapy for unresectable retroperitoneal sarcomas. Findings suggest that higher linear energy transfer distribution within the gross tumor volume is associated with improved local control.

articles.title: Clinical Outcomes of Proton and Conventional Radiation For Stage IIA and IIB Seminoma
articles.summary: This study reviews clinical outcomes for Stage IIA/IIB seminoma patients treated with radiation therapy. The authors note that modern techniques, including proton therapy, warrant further investigation to maintain high clinical efficacy while reducing long-term toxicities.

articles.title: Transforming Stereotactic Radiosurgery with Artificial Intelligence: Toward Intelligent Planning and Streamlined Workflows
articles.summary: This article explores the integration of artificial intelligence in stereotactic radiosurgery to enhance treatment planning efficiency. It addresses the clinical challenge of managing increasing patient volumes and complex multi-lesion cases.

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Artificial Intelligence-Based Identification of Malignant Lymph Nodes on CT for a Prospective Trial of Involved Nodal Versus Elective Neck Radiotherapy
articles.summary: This study introduces a CT-based artificial intelligence model for identifying malignant lymph nodes in the neck. The model includes uncertainty estimation, which helps determine when clinician review is necessary, potentially enhancing clinical trial workflows.

articles.title: Systematic evaluation of energy window and reconstruction parameters for quantitative lutetium-177 SPECT imaging on a CZT-based starguide SPECT/CT system
articles.summary: This medical physics study establishes a standardized workflow for quantitative 177Lu SPECT imaging. The results support improved accuracy for personalized dosimetry in radiopharmaceutical therapy applications.

articles.title: A Dosimetric and Biological Comparison of Volumetric Modulated Arc Therapy and Adaptive Aperture Proton Therapy for Hippocampal-Sparing Whole-Brain Radiotherapy
articles.summary: This dosimetric study evaluates the benefits of adaptive aperture intensity-modulated proton therapy for whole-brain radiotherapy. The research highlights improved organ-at-risk sparing capabilities compared to traditional volumetric modulated arc therapy.

articles.title: Interpreting Dose LET volume histograms using difference mapping in Spot Delete proton planning
articles.summary: Researchers demonstrate that Spot Delete planning can reduce elevated-LET skin exposure in proton therapy. The study highlights that conventional dose-volume histograms may miss these benefits, and suggests difference mapping as a more effective analytical tool.

articles.title: Refining risk assessment in 177 Lu-DOTATATE extravasation: the value of 3D Monte Carlo dosimetry
articles.summary: This study highlights the importance of 3D Monte Carlo dosimetry in assessing the impact of radioisotope extravasation. The high-resolution spatial data provided by this method allows for a more accurate interpretation of potential clinical outcomes compared to traditional MIRD approaches.

articles.title: CY 2027 Medicare Final Rules and Impact on Proton Therapy
articles.summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) released final rules for the 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule and Hospital Outpatient Prospective Payment System. The updates include payment adjustments that will increase reimbursement for most proton therapy services in hospital-based settings, while impacting the billing structure for providers.

articles.title: BayCare Proton Center Treats First Patient on Mevion S250 FIT™ with Leo Cancer Care's Marie® Solution
articles.summary: BayCare Proton Center has initiated clinical operations using the Mevion S250 FIT proton therapy system integrated with Leo Cancer Care's upright patient positioning technology.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a radiation oncology clinic, underscoring significant geographic disparities in access to cancer care. The findings emphasize the ongoing challenges in providing equitable radiation treatment coverage across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: The American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO) has released updated clinical guidelines regarding the use of shorter-course radiation therapy for patients with localized prostate cancer. These evidence-based updates aim to provide clinicians with standardized recommendations for treatment fractionation.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has successfully treated the first patient in a clinical trial investigating the use of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer, marking a milestone in high-dose-rate research.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has inaugurated a new wellness facility dedicated to supporting patients and their caregivers. This regional development enhances the supportive care infrastructure at this key proton therapy center in the DMV area.
